typed_scope.broadcast: Length1 vectors broadcast; original start length controls rounded rows.
typed_scope.input_storage: Caller-proven native-endian complete signed byte spans; unaligned/gapped/negative strides read with memcpy.
typed_scope.numeric_boundary: Finite coordinates with absolute value strictly below2**52; refuse wide uint64 decreasing/wrapped domains; float16 count<=65504; output count*dimensions*8 fits ptrdiff. No512-point capture quota.
typed_scope.output: Caller-owned buffers and explicit signed byte point/dimension strides; intptr_t integer or binary16/float32/float64 floating words. Wrapper owns array/base/scalar/container layout.
typed_scope.allocation: No allocation in kernel; fixed8dimension prepared snapshots. Refused preparation leaves output plan unchanged.
typed_scope.scalar_modulo_policy: Explicit LineNDScalarPromotion legacy_float64/weak_input. SDK default legacy_float64 documents NumPy1 scalar remainder; weak_input rounds remainder to f16/f32 precision. Python samples actual scalar result dtype once at runtime boundary; no fixture ID or version-output selection in kernel.

source_stages: Read operands once, original-dtype stop-start/abs before ceil(max) count; int8 and uint8 wrap preserved.
Convert integer operands to double only for linspace; float16/32 retain precision at delta/divide/arange/multiply/add storage stages.
Any zero step selects divide-index-then-multiply-delta for every dimension; zero/one point and endpoint override preserved.

Only first len(start) rows apply safe floor when first%1 in selected scalar-promotion precision equals0.5 and second-first in coordinate precision equals positive1. Otherwise nearest-even; remaining broadcast rows truncate at final int cast.
Capture divide/multiply underflow facts for caller FP policy, including software binary16 inexact-tiny storage conversion; restore calling FENV.
Scalar form and error/callback/provider semantics remain separate frontend responsibility.

execution.workers: Caller snapshots global budget once, default1. No kernel global read or private pool.
execution.parallel: Independent dimensions, optional GNU OpenMP when compiled; compiler-portable build serial; tested explicit1/4 budgets and threshold-crossing independent holdout.
execution.simd: Compiler independent-coordinate loops, contraction disabled. Observed Clang packed two-double vectorization in contiguous f64 loops; GCC plan SLP only, arithmetic-loop SIMD remains open. No custom ISA kernel/AVX2 claim.

additional_holdouts: Large two-dimensional exact unit steps crossing optional parallel threshold
Refused empty and mixed-dtype geometry leaves prepared plan unchanged
Caller FENV flags preserved; input mutation after preparation cannot alter output
Actual original f32 negative-near-half supplement differs by profile and both match exact0ULP
Independent f16 near-half policy split; f64 policy invariance; descending signed-unit-step never selects positive-one floor

unassessed: Mixed input dtypes, dimensions beyond8 and unsupported floating environments
Nonfinite and unsafe wide integer/narrowing/overflow partitions outside preparation domain
Python errors, scalar tuple/NumPy scalar identity, __array__ callbacks and FP-handler invocation order until separately proven frontend integration
Public shared-base ownership/layout, native registration, installed SDK and genuine artifact qualification
GCC arithmetic-loop SIMD and one-thread performance; no speed claim from component correctness/codegen
